reason: Roadmap source for rewrite-check evaluator scope and deferrals.
Learning outcome semantics for correct, partly correct, and incorrect checks.
Existing structured AI review contract patterns to mirror without overexpanding.
Provider diagnostics and raw output storage must respect local-first/privacy expectations.
Provider/config/validation failures need consistent retryable handling.
Evaluator output and service result types must be validated.
Persistence of check attempts must follow database conventions.
Saving submitted text and check attempts crosses persistence boundaries.
TypeScript quality conventions for backend and shared contracts.
